title: packit: koji and bodhi job targets taken from rawhide config
body:
While packit syncs the .packit.yaml config from upstream to Fedora on every upstream release, when it comes to the `koji_build` and `bodhi_update` jobs for all branches on the downstream repo / dist-git, packit only looks at the .packit.yaml in `rawhide`.

So, in the .packit.yaml that will end up on Fedora rawhide (currently v6 branch), we need the `koji_build` and `bodhi_update` jobs to include all eligible targets.

Without this change, I had to manually run `slash-packit koji-build` and `slash-packit create-update` on the downstream Packit PRs like: https://src.fedoraproject.org/rpms/podman/pull-request/334#comment-341782

Likewise, these two jobs in the `.packit.yaml` on the Fedora release branches will be noops.

The `propose_downstream` job should continue to use only those targets for which the release is intended.
